description: Single-provider second opinion via grok (advisory, single-shot). Pass `expert` to apply one of the expert personas. Calls the external grok provider (needs XAI_API_KEY; rate limits apply) and returns a text-wrapped JSON envelope { result }.

cwd.description: Working directory the provider runs in (used to resolve relative file refs). Defaults to the server process directory.

developerInstructions.description: Optional system/developer instructions injected verbatim; overrides the built-in persona for `expert`.

expert.description: Optional persona: architect, plan-reviewer, scope-analyst, code-reviewer, security-analyst, researcher, debugger, or writing-editor. On a named expert tool the tool's own persona wins and this is ignored.

files.description: Optional attachments for providers that read files (Grok/OpenRouter; inlined as context for Codex/Gemini). Each item is EXACTLY ONE of path/dir/file_id/file_url.

dir.description: Directory to attach; expanded recursively by providers that support it.

file_id.description: Id of a file already uploaded to the provider (e.g. Grok Files API).

file_url.description: Public URL for the provider to fetch.

headBytes.description: Path entries only: send only the first N bytes, cut at a line break and marked as truncated (inline; not with mode upload).

mode.description: Delivery: auto (size-based), inline (embed as text), or upload (provider Files API).

path.description: Path to a single file to attach (resolved against cwd).

preset.description: OpenRouter preset id or slug (e.g. 'cheapest-first') to route request or override parameters.

prompt.description: The question or task for the provider(s)/expert.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning depth where the provider supports it (Grok, OpenRouter): low, medium, high, or none. CLI providers (Codex, Gemini) ignore it.

runId.description: Optional run id from `panel`; groups parallel calls into one dashboard run. An id this server's `panel` did not open is ignored.

name: ask-grok
